bodies: International Society of Certified Electronics Technicians (ISCET)

exams.name: ETA Associate Electronics Technician (CETa)
exams.blurb: Foundational electronics credential covering basic DC/AC theory, test equipment and safety for entry technicians.

exams.name: ETA Certified Electronics Technician (CET)
exams.blurb: Mid-level credential covering communications, digital and analog electronics for consumer and industrial service.

exams.name: ETA Certified Journeyman Lineman
exams.blurb: Credential covering electrical distribution, climbing, safety and switching for overhead and underground power line workers.

exams.name: ETA Fiber Optics Installer/Technician
exams.blurb: Credential covering splicing, termination and testing of fiber optic cable for communications and data networks.

exams.name: ETA Renewable Energy Photovoltaic Installer
exams.blurb: Credential covering safe installation and commissioning of residential and small commercial photovoltaic systems.

exams.name: NFPA Certified Fire Inspector I (CFI-I)
exams.blurb: Certifies conduct of fire inspections, hazard identification and code enforcement per NFPA 1031.

exams.name: NFPA Certified Fire Plan Examiner (CFPE)
exams.blurb: Certifies review of fire protection drawings and specifications for code compliance before construction approval.

exams.name: NFPA Certified Fire Protection Specialist (CFPS)
exams.blurb: Global credential covering fire prevention, protection technology, codes and risk analysis for fire protection professionals.

exams.name: NFPA Certified Water-Based Systems Professional (CWBSP)
exams.blurb: Certifies design and analysis of automatic sprinkler and water-based fire protection systems per NFPA 13, 20 and 25.

exams.name: QEI Qualified Elevator Inspector Level 1 (Elevators)
exams.blurb: Certifies inspectors of elevators for jurisdictions enforcing ASME A17.1 and A17.2 safety codes.

exams.name: QEI Qualified Inspector Level 2 (Escalators/Moving Walks)
exams.blurb: Certifies inspectors of escalators and moving walks for compliance with ASME A17.1 and A17.2.

exams.name: QEI Qualified Inspector Level 3 (Material/Wheelchair Lifts)
exams.blurb: Certifies inspectors of material and wheelchair lifts for compliance with ASME A18.1 safety standards.

exams.name: NCCER Electrician Certification
exams.blurb: Module-based apprenticeship training in electrical theory, wiring, motors and the National Electrical Code.

exams.name: NCCER Welding Certification
exams.blurb: Module-based craft training in SMAW, GMAW, FCAW and GTAW culminating in a verifiable welding credential and transcript.

exams.name: NAEC Certified Accessibility Technician (CAT)
exams.blurb: Certifies technicians servicing vertical platform and wheelchair lifts for accessibility compliance.

exams.name: NAEC Certified Elevator Technician (CET)
exams.blurb: Certifies elevator and escalator maintenance technicians across electrical, hydraulic and traction systems.

exams.name: BICSI Installer 2 and Technician (INSTC/TECH)
exams.blurb: Credentials covering installation, termination and testing of copper and fiber cabling pathways and spaces.

exams.name: ISCET Certified Electronics Technician
exams.body: International Society of Certified Electronics Technicians (ISCET)
exams.blurb: Credential covering consumer electronics, communications and industrial electronic service and troubleshooting.

exams.name: Certified Flooring Installers (CFI)
exams.blurb: Certifies installers of carpet, hardwood, laminate and resilient flooring through hands-on performance testing.

exams.name: Certified Tile Installer (CTI)
exams.blurb: Hands-on credential verifying proper ceramic and stone tile installation, substrate prep and waterproofing.

exams.name: National Glass Association Certified Glass Technician (CGT)
exams.blurb: Certifies glaziers in fabrication, installation and sealing of architectural glass and storefront systems.

exams.name: NRCA ProCert Roof System Installer
exams.blurb: Certifies installers of specific roof systems including asphalt, thermoplastic and modified bitumen membranes.

exams.name: SAIA Scaffold Competent Person / Supervisor (SST)
exams.blurb: Certifies competent persons and supervisors for scaffold erection, inspection and fall protection compliance.

exams.name: API 1104 Pipeline Welder Qualification
exams.blurb: Qualification to weld transmission pipelines per API 1104, covering procedure, visual inspection and destructive testing.

exams.name: ASME Section IX Welder and Procedure Qualification
exams.blurb: Qualification under the ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code covering welder performance and welding procedure specs.

exams.name: Certified Robotic Arc Welding (CRAW)
exams.blurb: Credential verifying a technician can set up, operate and troubleshoot robotic arc welding cells in automated fabrication.

exams.name: NIMS Welding Credentials
exams.blurb: Job-skill credentials in welding, cutting and thermal joining aligned to national metalworking standards for manufacturing.
